headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.22
summary: This release fixes a launch crash and an AI papercut: Instance Settings crashed for every user on the stacked layout because the clear-cache button it binds was missing there, and the AI crash-analysis result dialog could not be scrolled while Markdown tables came out as raw pipe characters.

items.text: Fixed a NullPointerException that crashed Instance Settings on open for every user on the stacked (non-two-pane) layout: the stacked page dropped the Management card's clear-cache section entirely, so the activity bound a missing button before the page ever rendered. The clear-cache card is back in the stacked design language, keeping the feature instead of just hiding the crash.

Made the AI crash-analysis result dialog usable on long answers: the result text no longer swallows vertical swipes so the content scrolls, and Markdown tables from the model now render as real tables instead of literal pipe characters (the model/provider picker lists already got the same scroll treatment).
